en: \bSycamore: See you later.
\bLysandre: The world must remain beautiful. I can't stand the thought of it becoming uglier.
\bLysandre: Let's see what potential you have hidden within you.
\bLysandre: You are not a chosen one!
\bIlima: Greetings! I have been observing your talents.
\bIlima: I sincerely look forward to your assistance.
\bIlima: I'll wait.
\rLana: Please allow me to join you.
\rLana: You look like you're well worth catching.
\rLana: Goodbye!
\bKiawe: The power of a roaring blaze burns within us.
\bKiawe: We'll fully display our vaunted dancing!
\bKiawe: No, don't!
\rMallow: Let me serve them up a plate of my Super Mallow Special!
\rMallow: Time to start cooking with gas!
\rMallow: See ya!
\bSophocles: I'm a tough kid. N-no, really! I'm a tough kid!
\bSophocles: Ooh, I wanna come along!
\bSophocles: See you later!
\rMina: Heyyy, you and your Pokémon would make a real pretty painting.
\rMina: Let's give 'em a grand trial!
\rMina: See ya! Alola!
\rAcerola: You'll be sorry if you don't take me with you!
\rAcerola: Fright them and fight them with me!
\rAcerola: Boooo!
\bHapu: I may be young, but that does not mean I will be outdone!
\bHapu: I will gladly come to your aid.
\bHapu: Until we meet again!
\bNanu: If you don't wanna battle, I'm going home.
\bNanu: Well, aren't we just merry companions.
\bNanu: Guess I can take it easy now.
\rOlivia: We'll grind them to dust, with my polished diamonds!
\rOlivia: You've got to have a certain level of polish to partner with me.
\rOlivia: Well, I'll see you later.
\rKahili: Let's see how far we can fly for my new personal best.
\rKahili: We'll be heading toward a hole in one!
\rKahili: I hope we meet again.
\bMolayne: The stars has always watch over our adventures.
\bMolayne: To aim for a better tomorrow!
\bMolayne: See you later.
\bHala: I'm glad to meet you, child.
\bHala: Our energy will be uncontained!
\bHala: See ya later!
\bHau: I know you wanna win... And I'm gonna make sure that happens!
\bHau: I'm totally on board for this!
\bHau: I'm out!
\rLillie: I'll do my best so that no Pokémon have to end up getting hurt!
\rLillie: I'll work hard for the team.
\rLillie: I'll see you soon, right?
\bGladion: You can't protect anything if you're weak.
\bGladion: Alright. Let's go.
\bGladion: See you around.
\rSelene: I'm fired up to the max! Bring it on!
\rSelene: Sweet! Come on, let's go try it out!
\rSelene: See you later!
\bElio: Don't worry, in the end, everything will be all right.
\bElio: I've got your back!
\bElio: See ya!
\bKukui: I wanna research your moves! Can't wait to get in there and battle!
\bKukui: Give it everything you've got! My body is ready. Woo!
\bKukui: See ya!
\rLusamine: You may find you have nothing left to protect if you stop caring your Pokemon.
\rLusamine: I promise I'll keep you safe...
\rLusamine: I'll see you again.
\bGuzma: Wanna see what destruction looks like? Here it is in human form!
\bGuzma: It's time to smash! Let's go break some stuff!
\bGuzma: Later.
\bEusine: I am determined, of my dreams, and victories.
\bEusine: Yes. Let's go together.
\bEusine: Farewell.
\rCheryl: Winning's all about striking the right balance of offense and defense.
\rCheryl: We should warn them, my Pokémon can be quite rambunctious.
\rCheryl: Until we meet again.
\rMira: Please! Please take me to the exit!
\rMira: Alright! They will be shocked by what Mira can do!
\rMira: Oh no!
\bRiley: It is a bit odd that I would be training here, but this is a good ground to strengthen myself.
\bRiley: Let's forego the small talk and proceed right to battle.
\bRiley: I'll be hanging around here.
\bBuck: Now this! This is a smoking-hot situation we would enjoy!
